name: petroleum-teaching-atlas
description: Buildless static teaching site; npm dependencies are for DOM regression checks only.

scripts.build: node tools/build-m1-case.cjs && node tools/build-mudlogging-cases.cjs && node tools/build-drilling-lessons.cjs && node tools/build-welllog.cjs && node tools/build-field-stage-pages.cjs && node tools/build-drilling-case-pages.cjs && node tools/build-welllog-case-pages.cjs && node tools/seismic/rebuild-stage.cjs && node tools/seismic/package-data.cjs && node tools/build-cementing-case-pages.cjs && node tools/build-completion-case-pages.cjs && node tools/build-perforation-case-pages.cjs && node tools/operations/build.cjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/course-outline.cjs tests/regression.cjs tests/m1-preview.cjs tests/routes-assets.cjs tests/mudlogging-cases.cjs tests/v2-experiments.cjs tests/v2-dom.cjs tests/geology.cjs tests/drilling.cjs tests/welllog.cjs tests/field-integration.cjs tests/drilling-pages.cjs tests/welllog-pages.cjs tests/seismic.cjs tests/cementing-models.cjs tests/cementing-pages.cjs tests/completion.cjs tests/completion-pages.cjs tests/perforation.cjs tests/perforation-pages.cjs tests/three-stages-integration.cjs tests/operations.cjs
scripts.seismic:prepare: python tools/seismic/fetch-data.py && python tools/seismic/prepare.py && node tools/seismic/package-data.cjs
